description: A completely headless, privacy-oriented media player add-on for NVDA that seamlessly plays audio and video files in the background with zero visible UI or taskbar footprint. Controlled via an exclusive modal keyboard interception layer with pitch-preserved variable speed, A-B repeat, chapter navigation, playlist management, and rich speech feedback. Includes YouTube and online streaming support (search, playlists, channels, live streams) powered by a bundled, self-updating yt-dlp engine.
